register.reg_long_name: PLB Invalidate All, EL1, Inner Shareable
register.reg_condition: when FEAT_S1POE2 is implemented and FEAT_AA64 is implemented

purpose_text.para: Invalidates cached copies of IRT, TTT, and DPOT entries from PLBs that meet all the following requirements:

listitem.content: The entry would be used in the EL1&0 translation regime in the current Security state.

purpose_text.para: The invaldation applies to entries with any VMID.
The invalidation applies to all PEs in the same Inner Shareable shareability domain as the PE that executes this System instruction.

attributes_text.para: PLBI ALLE1IS, PLBI ALLE1ISNXS is a 64-bit System instruction.

field_description.para: The following set of FEAT_TLBID behaviors apply to PLBI operations:

listitem.content: TLBI Domain numbering for PLBs matches that used for TLBs.
HCRX_EL2.{VTLBIDEn, VTLBIDOSEn} causes the TLBID value specified in PLBI instructions executed at EL1 to be transformed.
The effect of HCR_EL2.FB and HCRX_EL2.FNB on PLBI instructions executed at EL1 that specify the Inner shareable domain, or do not specify the Inner or Outer shareable domain.
The effect of SCTLR2_ELx.TLBOSNIS on PLBI OS instructions executed at EL1 and EL2.

access_permission_text.para: If FEAT_TLBID is not implemented, the Rt field should be set to 0b11111. If the Rt field is not set to 0b11111, it is CONSTRAINED UNPREDICTABLE whether:

content.para: The instruction behaves as if the Rt field is set to 0b11111.

access_permission_text.para: This system instruction is an alias of the SYS instruction.

The following pseudocode describes traps which apply to the System instruction. For information about changes to the scope of the invalidation to the instruction under different conditions, see AArch64_PLBI_ALL() in the Pseudocode for AArch64 operation.
